text:
anya (Support): heads-up — Enterprise customer AcmeCorp hit a major support escalaton after the morning client regen. Symptoms: immediate 401s, client auto-retries (5x), large token billing spike, and higher tail latency. Repro steps below. Can DevEx + Eng look? :grimacing:

marco (DevEx): thanks, sharing logs + minimal repro helps. do we have a request id / trace?

anya (Support): trace ids from their app: trace=tx-9a8b; sample log:
```
2026-03-17T09:12:03Z ERROR request failed status=401 request_id=tx-9a8b path=/v1/generate
2026-03-17T09:12:03Z INFO sdk retry attempt=1 reason=401
2026-03-17T09:12:03Z INFO sdk retry attempt=2 reason=401
```
Customer says this started right after we published regenerated TS + Python clients at 08:45 UTC.

ravi (Client Tools): rough timeline matches. new generator template we merged this morning accidentally flipped the retry policy to include 4xx for idempotent methods. that's a bug. but 401 should never be retried.

tim (Eng-Infra): also seeing a small config change in the generated TS client — auth header is set via `headers['authorization'] = token` (lowercase) instead of `Authorization`. server accepts case-insensitive headers normally, but our edge proxy has a bug where it normalizes headers and then an internal filter expects `Authorization` exact-case. investigating.

zoe (SRE): if the proxy dropped header for some requests, that would cause 401 + automatic retry and explain the spike. we should check gateway logs for tx-9a8b. I pulled the gateway trace: http://internal-gateway/traces/tx-9a8b — shows header absent on one of the retries.

anya (Support): repro steps customer provided (sanitized):
```
# install regenerated client v2.1.0
npm i @redwood/client@2.1.0
# minimal node snippet
const c = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: 'Bearer abc123' });
await c.generate({ model: 'x', prompt: 'hi' });
```
They also tried curl which worked once but client kept retrying: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer abc123" https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate` returned 200.

marco (DevEx): two parallel issues: (A) generator changed client default retry policy to include 4xx (should not), (B) header-case normalization in proxy + generator lowercasing created intermittent auth drop. Combined causes retries and billing.

ravi (Client Tools): quick repro I ran locally:
```
# simulate token header lowercasing
node -e "const fetch=require('node-fetch'); fetch('http://local-proxy/v1/generate', {headers: {'authorization': 'Bearer abc123'}}).then(r=>console.log(r.status));"
# generator's retry code (pseudo)
if (err.status >= 500 || (options.retryOn4xx && err.status >= 400)) { retry(); }
```
Repro shows proxy variant returns 401 when header key not exact.

tim (Eng-Infra): immediate mitigation options:
- rollback TS/Python client releases to 2.0.7 (pre-regen) on npm/pypi pinned packages for the enterprise rollout (we can yank 2.1.0).
- hotfix generator to restore retry policy and cut 2.1.1.
- patch proxy header normalization so it treats lowercase `authorization` as equivalent (short term).

zoe (SRE): I'll open an incident to track mitigation. we should also rate-limit retries from SDKs to protect billing while we fix.

marco (DevEx): agreed. I'll draft the release note & rollback steps. Also add a CI test to the client-generator repo that verifies we don't retry on 4xx and that auth header appears in an end-to-end smoke test.

ravi (Client Tools): bisect plan: run generator CI on commits from this morning. suspected PR: `feat: default retry options` merged at 07:50 UTC — commit 5f8b2cd. I'll run a regen with that commit removed and run our smoke e2e.

ci-bot: regen-ci job #4523 finished — status: failed — e2e auth-smoke test failed (401). Job log: https://ci.internal/jobs/4523/logs

marco (DevEx): patch created: https://git.internal/client-generator/pulls/189 — reverts retry change + adds e2e. Please review quickly.

tim (Eng-Infra): short-term proxy patch pushed to canary (rev a3c1) that normalizes header names before filter. Rolling to 10% now. If canary looks good we'll promote.

anya (Support): customer updated: they disabled auto-update to pinned 2.0.7 and reduced retries in their app; still angry but stable. They're asking for timeline & postmortem.

marco (DevEx): action items assigned:
- ravi: cut client-generator hotfix and publish 2.1.1 with retry revert (ETA 60m).
- tim/zoe: monitor canary -> promote proxy patch (ETA 30–60m).
- marco: prepare rollback instructions + customer note, add CI test to prevent future drift (ETA 2h).

ravi (Client Tools): started PR CI run now. will post publish link when npm/pypi artifacts are live.

zoe (SRE): monitoring: spike in token usage for AcmeCorp peaked at 09:18 UTC and is back to baseline after mitigation flags. alerting rule updated to trigger on repeated 401+retries per minute.

marco (DevEx): postmortem checklist: root cause = generator change that expanded retry set + subtle proxy header normalization mismatch. CI gap = no auth smoke at regen-time and no changelog note. We'll include remediation: stricter prepublish smoke tests, changelog policy, and a gating rule for retry policy changes.

anya (Support): thanks all — keeping customer in loop. I'll attach this thread to the support ticket and follow up with ETA. :pray:

ravi (Client Tools): published 2.1.1 -> npm/pypi: https://pkg.internal/@redwood/client/2.1.1 (fix: revert retry-on-4xx + tests).

marco (DevEx): closing the loop — please add any follow-ups to the postmortem doc in /docs/incidents when ready.

zoe (SRE): can confirm proxy canary had no auth-drops; promoting to 100% now.

anya (Support): customer accepted mitigation and asked for root-cause writeup. I'll draft the customer-facing summary after internal postmortem.

(End of thread)
